Momahaṇa
son of Prayāgadāsa, grandson of Harivāghala.
--Momahaṇagranthapraśastipata. See below.
--Momahaṇavilāsa. med. wrote in 1412, under Mahmūd Sāh, son of Firoz Sāh. See below. [Page197-b]

Momahaṇagranthapraśastipatra
kāvya. by Momahaṇa, son of Prayāgadāsa. RORI.

Momahaṇavilāsa
med. on disease peculiar to women an. children. by Momahaṇa, son of Prayāgadāsa. Filliozat
